title: DC Comics Presents Elseworlds 100-Page Spectacular #1 2012 Super-Sons Kyle Baker
conditionDescription: Square-bound with light spine and edge wear, small creases near the bottom left of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
DC Comics Presents: Elseworlds 100-Page Spectacular #1 (January 2012), DC Comics one-shot. Reprints the stories from the 1999 Elseworlds 80-Page Giant (the issue DC recalled and pulped), including Kyle Baker's "Letitia Lerner, Superman's Babysitter" and the Super-Sons, plus a story from The Batman Chronicles #11. Space Oddities, Tall Tales, World's Finest Dinner Theatre. Direct sales, $7.99 cover price.

Back cover: Smallville final season DVD ad.

Condition: square-bound with light spine and edge wear and small creases near the bottom left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
